heroSummary: Dysart students begin the 2029–30 school year on Wednesday, August 1, 2029, and the last day of school is Thursday, May 23, 2030. Fall Break is October 8–12, Thanksgiving Recess is November 19–23, Winter Break is December 21–January 7, and Spring Break is March 18–22. Monday early dismissal begins August 6 and applies on Mondays when school is in session. The reviewed PDF lists Graduation Day as TBD.
calendarNotes: The official Dysart 2029–30 school calendar lists 180 student days. K–8 quarter counts are 47, 43, 47, and 43 days; high school semesters are evenly split at 90 and 90 days. Early release does not work the same way for every grade level: Mondays when school is in session, K–8 conference days, high school final-exam days, and semester-end dates use separate schedules.

customSections.label: Schedule Changes Families Should Know About
customSections.content: Early release does not work the same way for every grade level. Students are dismissed early on Mondays when school is in session for teacher professional development. K–8 students also have early release for conferences on October 4–5 and February 7–8. High school students are released early for final exams on December 19–20 and May 22–23. On May 23, K–8 students are also released early for the last day of school.
